result.reply:
B-2002 has a graduated rent (Staffelmiete), and the rent goes up 3 percent every year [B-2002#s4]. The current rent is 2350 EUR/month, and utilities of 320 EUR per month are listed separately [B-2002].

With a graduated rent, all future increases are written into the lease in advance, either as amounts or as dates with new rents. Each increase must come at least one year after the previous one [policy:graduated-rent#how-it-works]. Between those planned increases, the landlord can't raise the rent to match the local rent index (Mietspiegel). Increases after modernisation are also ruled out [policy:graduated-rent#what-it-excludes].

The listing doesn't give the exact year-by-year amounts or how long the graduated rent lasts. If you'd like that schedule, I can pass your question to a colleague.
